rows.grounds: compound denoting a measure of forty units; taken as the extent specified
fused form expressing starting from that point; internal sandhi noted but token kept whole
compound denoting a measure taken as a multiple; alternative extent specified

items.question: What alternative extent of forty units or a multiple measure is prescribed from that starting point?
premises: An extent of forty measures is specified as one option.
The disjunctive particle presents an alternative specification.
A multiple measure starting from that point is given as the alternative.
items.inference: The prescribed extent may be either forty measures or a multiple measure taken from that starting point.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the starting point indicated by tasmādau depends on the preceding ritual context.
The precise value implied by guṇamātrakam is not fully explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Alternatively, the measure is forty units, or a multiple measure taken from that starting point.
